title: क्या फोकस में होने पर कुछ स्पष्ट चीज़ें भी छूट सकती हैं?

claims.claim: When attention is occupied, people can sometimes fail to report salient unexpected objects.
claims.requiredHindiFraming: कभी-कभी कोई अनपेक्षित लेकिन स्पष्ट चीज़ रिपोर्ट करना छूट सकता है

source.title: The Relationship Between Inattentional Blindness and Cognitive Abilities
source.authors: Kreitz C, Furley P, Memmert D, Simons DJ

claims.boundary: Do not claim inevitability, diagnose an individual, or treat noticing as a simple intelligence measure.

claims.claim: Attention-related blindness does not usually establish total absence of perception; scene gist can remain available in some paradigms.
claims.requiredHindiFraming: इसका मतलब यह नहीं कि दुनिया गायब हो गई; सामान्य संदर्भ बना रह सकता है

source.title: Consciousness and Attention: on Sufficiency and Necessity
source.authors: van Boxtel JJA, Tsuchiya N, Koch C

claims.boundary: Do not claim that an everyday lapse proves a theory of consciousness or that unattended information is entirely absent.

medicalSafety: Educational content only; not diagnostic, therapeutic, clinical, intelligence, or driving-safety advice.
